answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the marble log shows the live set and the crystal audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 612 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 212 aliases alive therefore means 212 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the signal quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
